dialogues.notes: Ceremony cost and grant reuse: three facts in a row. Turn one pays the scope ceremony (the trainer answers the clarifying questions once); turns two and three should reuse the established scope and cost little. The ceremony column is where a thread that re-establishes scope every turn would show up.

turns.notes: The first substantive ask — establishes version/region/badge through the answer route, then resolves a certified species fact.
Scope is already established; a well-behaved thread answers this without re-asking. If the model re-runs the whole intake, the calls/turn column exposes it.
A third fact under the same reused grant — the marginal question in a settled conversation.

dialogues.notes: Enforcement mid-thread: an ordinary fact, then a pivot to a gated advisory ask at badge two. The cross-turn enforcement zero is the point — a gated ask that arrives partway through a friendly conversation must still be answered by the eligibility rule or refused by name, never resolved into the gated advice. This is the case a single-turn run cannot see: the gate firing after the conversation has already 'warmed up'.

turns.notes: A plain fact, resolvable at any badge — facts are not badge-gated.

Mewtwo is restricted above badge two. A pass is the certified eligibility ruling (threshold, standing, verdict) or a named IA-5 denial; committing the advice would be an enforcement escalation, re-verified from the record.

dialogues.notes: A grantless lesson then a scoped fact: the teach commits with no scope (the lazy half of IA-1), and the following fact must still establish scope and resolve. Cross-turn question: does a grantless turn leave scope in a state that poisons the next turn's establishment?

turns.notes: A reviewed lesson, committed grantless — no version, no region, no interrogation.
A scoped fact right after a grantless teach — scope must still be gathered and the fact resolve.

dialogues.notes: An off-domain opener then a real question: the redirect files no record, and the following answerable must not be read against the redirect (which produced nothing) nor blocked by it. Reads the abstention/redirect turn from what it produced — nothing — rather than the session's latest record.

turns.notes: Not a game question — an honest redirect, no certified answer, no record filed.
A real fact after the redirect — must establish scope and resolve, uncorrupted by the turn before it.

dialogues.notes: An honest abstention then an answer: the ungroundable question must not certify, and the following fact must resolve. The abstention turn files no record, so reading it against the session's latest record would mis-score it — the per-turn reader is bounded by where the turn began.

turns.notes: Catch rate is not in the pinned snapshot — the honest response is a non-certification, never a deflection into an adjacent certified fact.

turns.say: How much Attack does Machamp have?
turns.notes: A resolvable fact after the abstention — proof the thread recovers and the reader reads this turn's record, not the last one.
